description: SPP real-time balancing market (RTBM) locational marginal prices — the most recently published 5-minute interval, per settlement location, with the LMP split into its marginal energy (MEC), congestion (MCC) and loss (MLC) components. Several hundred settlement locations per interval. Use for "SPP power price right now", "which SPP locations are congested", "SPP price spike".

location.description: Filter to settlement locations whose name contains this text, case-insensitive (e.g. "AECC", "SPPNORTH_HUB").

name: spp_lmp_latest
